qualification.details: Sr. Project Assistant : M.A. degree in any discipline with a minimum of 55% marks (a B.Lib degree is desirable). Minimum 5 years of working experience in office management within a government office or educational institute, with expertise in meeting scheduling, GeM procurement, bill processing, and laboratory management. Candidates must possess basic knowledge of HTML/CSS, experience with CMS platforms such as Joomla or WordPress, and proficiency in MS Office (Word, Excel) including cloud-based MS Office applications.

how_to_apply: Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience.
Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs.
Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email.
Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification.
Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 02-09-2026.
Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Delhi Sr. Project Assistant (Admin.) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the IIT Delhi Sr. Project Assistant (Admin.) position is 02-09-2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Sr. Project Assistant (Admin.) post?
faq.answer: Candidates need to have an M.A. degree in any discipline with a minimum of 55% marks. A B.Lib degree is considered desirable.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for the Sr. Project Assistant (Admin.) position?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Sr. Project Assistant (Admin.) post at IIT Delhi.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Sr. Project Assistant (Admin.) role?
faq.answer: The salary for the Sr. Project Assistant (Admin.) position ranges from Rs. 47,790 to Rs. 62,350 per month, plus HRA at 27%.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications for this recruitment must be submitted via email.

faq.question: Q6. Does IIT Delhi offer age relaxation for reserved categories?
faq.answer: Please refer to the official notification for details regarding age relaxation for reserved categories.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Sr. Project Assistant (Admin.) post?
faq.answer: The selection process for this position will involve an Online Interview.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for applying to this post?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q9. What is the required experience for the Sr. Project Assistant (Admin.) role?
faq.answer: A minimum of 5 years of working experience in office management within a government office or educational institute is required.

faq.question: Q10. What are the key responsibilities of a Sr. Project Assistant (Admin.) at IIT Delhi?
faq.answer: Key responsibilities include meeting scheduling, GeM procurement, bill processing, laboratory management, and proficiency in basic HTML/CSS, CMS platforms, and MS Office.
